summary: Most consequential: the joint-problem rule fires on any single difficulty with walking/sitting/standing (page says unable to do all actions comfortably), and sprain/strain drop 'recent' and 'one joint'. Sciatica uses invented left/right laterality, and Muscle pain (any site) broadens triggers. The red-box diagnoses, DVT, acute/critical ischaemia, PVD and heart failure are faithful and correctly probable.
